by
  intro f s c M hs hc hd hM
  refine ⟨Function.update f c (Filter.limUnder (nhdsWithin c {c}ᶜ) f), ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine Complex.differentiableOn_update_limUnder_of_bddAbove (hs.mem_nhds hc) hd ⟨M, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact hM z hz
  · intro z hz
    exact Function.update_of_ne hz.2 _ _
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (s : Set ℂ) (c : ℂ) (M : ℝ), IsOpen s → c ∈ s → DifferentiableOn ℂ f (s \ {c}) → (∀ z ∈ s \ {c}, ‖f z‖ ≤ M) → ∃ g : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ g s ∧ ∀ z ∈ s \ {c}, g z = f z
